name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
title: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd - 542650 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Metropolis Q1 FY27 revenue rose 17% YoY to INR 450 crore with EBITDA margin up 210 bps to 25.2%, driven mostly by volume.
summary.overview: Revenue grew about 17% YoY to INR 450 crore, ahead of guidance, with 10% patient volume and 11% test volume growth and no price increase in 18 months. EBITDA rose 27% YoY to INR 113 crore (25.2% margin, +210 bps) and PAT rose 26% to INR 57 crore (12.6% margin, +90 bps). Management reiterated FY27 revenue growth of 14-15% and a 100-150 bps EBITDA margin improvement, with a 27-28% margin target over the next two years. Network expansion continued (300 centers added in Q1, 500+ planned), while the company pruned about 300 low-productivity centers.

segments.name: B2C
segments.commentary: Revenue +18% YoY; patient volume ~+13.5%. Specialty within B2C +21%; rural centers +36%.

segments.name: B2B
segments.commentary: Revenue +15% YoY (now including Core in the base); patient volume ~+6%. Focus on hospitals, MD labs and institutions, mostly Specialty tests.

segments.name: TruHealth
segments.commentary: 18% of Q1 revenue, +22% YoY; radiology-integrated wellness packages +40%+, premium packages +50%+. Ticket size ~INR 2,500.

segments.name: Specialty Diagnostics
segments.commentary: 40% of Q1 revenue, +17% YoY; target to lift share to 45% from 40%. Genomics portfolio doubled over the past year.

segments.name: Core Diagnostics
segments.commentary: Margin in high single digits (~8% at Q4 FY26 end); target ~25% EBITDA margin within 3-4 years of acquisition. Effective acquisition multiple ~10x FY27 EBITDA per management.

segments.name: International
segments.commentary: Management said business grew healthily in revenue and EBITDA; market leader in 2 of 5 countries. No figures given.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth of 14-15%, expected to be primarily volume-led; medium-term CAGR also 14-15% (about 9-10% from patient volume, rest from mix).
EBITDA margin expansion of 100-150 bps in FY27 (the CFO-level answer cited 120-150 bps in one reply); target EBITDA margin of 27-28% over this year and next.
Plan to open ~400-500 centers in Tier-2/Tier-3 towns this year; net addition of 500+ centers in FY27.
Center-to-lab ratio to improve from 1:24 in Q1 to ~1:30 by year-end.
No price increase planned near term; intent to pass on part of inflation at an appropriate time.
FY27 capex expected similar to FY26's INR 65 crore (group basis, including acquired entities).
capex_capacity: FY26 group capex was INR 65 crore; FY27 capex guided to be in a similar range.
Added ~300 service centers in Q1 FY27 and more than 500 over the last 12 months; now operating across 750 towns.
Center-to-lab ratio improved from 1:21 a year ago to 1:24 in Q1; target ~1:30 by year-end.
Lab expansion has been halted for about five quarters; no further expansion beyond 750 towns planned.
Pruned ~300 low-productivity or quality-issue centers this quarter (done after ~2 years), with no material revenue impact per management.
Lab-on-lease model run for ~10 years; number of such labs not disclosed (to be followed up).
demand_pricing: No price increase since January 2025; Q1 growth was predominantly volume and mix, with realisations contributing the balance of the 17%.
Specialty and TruHealth mix drove ~5-6% realisation benefit, per management.
CGHS price revision was the only industry-wide price increase; contribution to Metropolis is about 1% of revenue.
Management described competition as normal; new entrants chasing volume at high servicing costs were said to struggle to make money.
Management said Tier-2/Tier-3 economics are not worse than metros; no GLP-1-specific volume split disclosed.
Q1 seasonality was stronger than usual; management could not fully explain the volume strength and cited possible overflow from Q4 and industry tailwinds.
